name: Bahamian Contractors Association
brand_truth: The construction industry's own voice since 1959, building the Bahamian horizon.
buyer: Bahamian contractors, subcontractors, suppliers and developers on phones; officials and foreign developers checking who represents the industry.

design.signature: Nassau skyline under construction assembling on load (rising floors, scaffold, crane swing); membership tier finder that emails the application; live event countdown; Contractors Act timeline

current_site_findings: The hero block is repeated a second time on the homepage.
Own site says founded 1959; ZNS says 1958.
Newest homepage post is from May 2025.
Membership prices are hidden in an FAQ accordion.
pitch_line: Your homepage spells 'Association' wrong twice and hides your dues in an FAQ; this concept lets a contractor find their tier and email their application in three taps, with the next Mix & Mingle counting down on the first screen.
assumptions: Skyfall event is 11 December 2026 (from event URL); start time not stated, countdown in days only
Revenue band mapping in the tier finder follows the published tier rules; suppliers/consultants default to Associate
notes: Record said Facebook only, but bahamiancontractors.org is live and was built in 2026 by another agency (Starfish Web Ventures): weaker pitch, approach as an upgrade (finder, clarity, typo fixes). No own photos used. President Leonard Sands is sourced but not featured.
